CVE-2016-8681.title: The _dwarf_get_abbrev_for_code function in dwarf_util.c in libdwa ...
CVE-2016-8681.description: The _dwarf_get_abbrev_for_code function in dwarf_util.c in libdwarf 20161001 and earlier allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read) by calling the dwarfdump command on a crafted file.

CVE-2020-27545.title: libdwarf before 20201017 has a one-byte out-of-bounds read becaus ...
CVE-2020-27545.description: libdwarf before 20201017 has a one-byte out-of-bounds read because of an invalid pointer dereference via an invalid line table in a crafted object.

CVE-2020-28163.title: libdwarf before 20201201 allows a dwarf_print_lines.c NULL pointe ...
CVE-2020-28163.description: libdwarf before 20201201 allows a dwarf_print_lines.c NULL pointer dereference and application crash via a DWARF5 line-table header that has an invalid FORM for a pathname.

CVE-2026-116732.title: libdwarf through 2.3.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnera ...
CVE-2026-116732.description: libdwarf through 2.3.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dwarf_debug_addr_table() that omits the table starting offset when validating .debug_addr unit length. Attackers can supply a crafted object file with a non-zero offset table, causing dwarf_debug_addr_by_index() to read past the heap buffer, disclosing adjacent heap bytes or crashing consumers.
